Name: No more slurping
Author: HokeyLoki
Description:
Only modifies dialogue for fall 18 festival and summer 11 festival, because she doesn't do it anywhere else in the game
This is my first time modding Stardew, so I used SquitzPrime's Content Patcher Dialogue Tutorial and templates: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2382/]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2382/[/url]

Must have Content Patcher installed:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]﻿

Just navigate to your mods folder in Stardew (Steam/Steamapps/Common/Stardew Valley/Mods; on linux: home/user/.steam/steam/steamapps/common/"Stardew Valley"/Mods), then create a new folder for this mod and extract the files into it.
